name: Typr
description: Local-first Typst, LaTeX, and Markdown workspace. The stable full image keeps projects in browser storage and needs no appdata volume. Trusted LAN/VPN use only; never expose it publicly.

paths.name: Compiler assets directory
paths.description: Optional exact compiler-release directory for lite/local only. Never map /, /mnt, /mnt/user, an appdata root, project files, or the Docker socket.

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: Host port for the Typr web interface. Container port must remain 8080.

variables.name: Compiler asset mode
variables.description: The full image uses local. For a lite image, use r2 without a mount or local with the exact matching read-only compiler pack.
